takeaway: Your GPS relies on Einstein's theories of relativity to function accurately. Without these corrections, it would drift 11 km daily!
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your daily commute, food delivery, and even finding your way home all rely on a mind-bending physics concept from over a century ago: Einstein's Theories of Relativity!

Here's the cosmic reality:
🔹 GPS satellites orbit Earth at high speeds and experience weaker gravity.
🔹 These relativistic effects make their clocks tick 38 microseconds faster per day compared to Earth-bound clocks.
🔹 Without constant, precise corrections based on Einstein's Special and General Relativity, your navigation would drift by a shocking 11 kilometers (6.8 miles) *every single day*!
